name: Component end-of-life exposure brief
summary: When a supplier announces a component constraint or end-of-life date, the sourcing lead gets one brief: where the part is used, stock and demand set against the stated dates, and questions about replacements, with unverified availability kept apart from approved supply.

sources.title: Fully Powered AI's own published map of reading a supplier's component notice against where-used, stock and demand records, with its own rules for prepared work
